title: Drone show in downtown Austin Friday 'Rick Rolled' Austinites
description:
If you watched the Sky Elements drone show Friday night in downtown Austin, a QR code 'Rick Rolled' Austinites. If you're not familiar with the term, it's a meme involving the unexpected appearance of the music video for "Never Gonna Give You up", by Rick Astley.
